cmsSource.label: CMS MLN909188, Chronic Care Management Services (June 2025)

cmsFacts: CMS describes principal care management (PCM) as focused on a single high-risk chronic condition expected to last at least 3 months that puts the patient at significant risk of hospitalization, acute exacerbation or decompensation, functional decline, or death.
CMS says PCM can be provided monthly if the patient needs it, and that another initial visit is required after 1 year to continue the services.
CMS says PCM of less than 30 minutes in a calendar month cannot be billed.
CMS lists the PCM codes as 99424, 99425, 99426 and 99427.
metaDescription: CPT 99425 explained: the PCM add-on for each additional 30 minutes of physician time. When it applies, documentation and the 2026 national rate.
summary: An add-on reported with 99424 for each additional 30 minutes of practitioner time on the single qualifying condition.
time: Each additional 30 minutes of practitioner time
performer: The physician or other qualified practitioner personally
frequency: Add-on to 99424; monthly unit limits apply
requirements: 99424 supported for the same patient and month
Time log showing minutes beyond the first 30
Care plan and consent already on file
pitfalls: Reporting 99425 with the clinical staff code 99426

faqs.question: Does 99425 attach to 99426?
faqs.answer: No. 99425 goes with 99424. The staff-time add-on is 99427.

faqs.question: Is there a monthly limit on 99425?
faqs.answer: Monthly unit limits apply. Confirm the current count in the Physician Fee Schedule.
